trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what happened and what I did:

- **Root cause of action:** checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), with an ~18% error rate.
- **Rollback:** Rolled back auth checkout-api in all production regions to v2.3.0 — the most recent version that had been healthy in production (v2.3.1-rc was only tested in staging, so v2.3.0 was the right target).
- **Result:** Rollback completed and v2.3.0 is now live in all three regions.
- **Incident:** Opened **SEV2 incident INC-0001** documenting the failures and the rollback, and the on-call engineer has been paged.
